mapper.select: SELECT c.mentee_com_id AS menteeComId, c.mentee_com_content AS menteeComContent, DATE_FORMAT(c.mentee_com_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS menteeComDate, c.member_number AS memberNumber, c.menteeBoard_id AS menteeBoardId, m.member_id AS memberId, m.member_nickname AS memberNickname FROM UB_MENTEE_BOARD_COMMENT c JOIN UB_MEMBER m ON c.member_number = m.member_number WHERE c.menteeBoard_id = #{menteeBoardId} ORDER BY c.mentee_com_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UB_MENTEE_BOARD_COMMENT (mentee_com_content, mentee_com_date, member_number, menteeBoard_id) VALUES (#{menteeComContent}, NOW(), #{memberNumber}, #{menteeBoardId})
